```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(llnl)
library(tidyverse)
library(eulerr)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
#load data
#Virome
virome.votu.table <- read.csv("../Data/normalized_abundance_tables//bulk_virome_normalized_table.csv",row.names = 1)

#Active
metat.votu.table <- read.csv("../Data/normalized_abundance_tables/active_votu_abundances.csv",row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
# Treatment-level Venn diagram from a vOTU table (rows = vOTUs, columns = samples)
treatment.venn <- function(votu.table, title){
  transpose_df <- t(votu.table)

  tp <- data.frame(timepoint = substr(row.names(transpose_df), 1, 2),
                   sample = row.names(transpose_df)) %>%
    mutate(Treatment = ifelse(grepl("T0", timepoint),
                              "Dry",
                              ifelse(grepl("P", sample),
                                     "Phosphorus",
                                     "No Phosphorus"))) %>%
    column_to_rownames("sample")

  pa.df <- merge(transpose_df, tp, by.x = "row.names", by.y = "row.names") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Row.names")

  df.mean <- pa.df %>%
    group_by(Treatment) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(dplyr::across(contains("NODE"), mean)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Treatment")

  fit.venn <- venn(t(df.mean) > 0)

  plot(fit.venn,
       quantities = list(template = "{counts}\n({percent})", fontsize = 12, col = "grey10"),
       fills = list(fill = c("burlywood4", "gray70", "#A71930"), alpha = 0.7),
       labels = list(col = "black", font = 2, fontsize = 15, position = "outside"),
       edges = list(col = "grey30", lwd = 1),
       legend = FALSE,
       main = list(label = title, fontsize = 17, font = 2))
}

trt_virome <- treatment.venn(virome.votu.table, "Virome")
trt_metat  <- treatment.venn(metat.votu.table, "Transcriptionally active viruses")
```

Combine figures
```{r}
# leave a strip above each panel so the A/B tags don't sit on the titles
pad <- function(p) ggdraw() + draw_plot(p, y = 0, height = 0.93)

venn.d <- plot_grid(pad(trt_virome), NULL, pad(trt_metat),
                    labels = c("A", "", "B"), label_size = 20,
                    ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(1, 0.08, 1)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))

ggsave("../figures/supplementary_fig2.png",
       venn.d,
       width = 12,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300,
       units = "in",
       bg = "transparent")
```
